product_metadata.title: Bagotte Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, 25Kpa Powerful Suction Stick Vacuum, 400W Brushless Motor, Up to 55mins Runtime, 8 in 1 Lightweight Stick Handheld Vacuum for Hard Floor Carpet Car Pet Hair
features: 25Kpa Strong Suction: Bagotte cordless vacuum cleaner is equipped with a 400W brushless motor to reach up to 25Kpa powerful suction for deep cleaning, 3 suction levels to meet your different cleaning demands. 2-3 hours fully charged, significantly shortens the charging time.

55 Minutes of Runtime: Powered by the latest digital motor technology, removable battery with up to 55 minutes of runtime measured at the hand vacuum in standard mode. Easily switch between 3 power modes with the press of a button.

8-in-1 multiple applications: we have prepared four different nozzles for this vacuum cleaner, including long splitting nozzle, 2-in-1 bristle brush, carpet brush, roller brush with which you can easily perform cleaning solid wood floors, tile floors and various carpets. The extension tubes can easily clean the vacuum cleaner hard-to-reach space.

Cordless and lightweight: Cordless vacuum is built for convenience and portability, giving you a free range of motion as you’re cleaning. And due to its lightweight construction and rotating floorhead, the cordless stick vacuum is highly maneuverable, extremely suitable for one hand cleaning and cleaning up from floor to high places.

Warranty and Filtration System: The integrated filtration system helps trap dust and allergens as you clean, and the washable HEPA filter keeps recurring costs to a minimum. Bagotte vacuum cleaner is backed by professional customer service and a 12-month warranty, please feel free to contact our customer team if you have any problems.
